lines: You cook on Wednesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Theodule eats.

You asked for one dish for everyone, and that is what was cooked. The shares of Aurele, Marceline and Solveig do not come out of the shared dish: they are served as close as they can be, with no dish apart.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Zesty Smoky Bean Tacos
dishes.title: Smoky black beans and charred peppers in corn tortillas
dishes.method: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds each side. Fill with a portion of the smoky beans and roasted vegetables. Squeeze over the lime and top with coriander.
dishes.why: A bright, fresh lunch that uses the smoky batch components without needing a full reheat, perfect for a busy Wednesday.

dishes.name: Hearty Smoky Bean Bowls
dishes.title: Smoky bean stew with roasted summer vegetables and brown rice
dishes.method: Reheat the beans and roasted vegetables in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot. Serve over the pre-cooked rice and top with sliced avocado.
dishes.why: This provides the 'slow-cooked' feel the house requested while respecting the one-oven-tray limit by using a stovetop bean base.

preparations.title: Smoky Three-Bean Batch (Lunch Portion)
preparations.method: Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Stir in chipotle paste and spices. Add beans and tomatoes, then simmer for 20 minutes until thickened. Divide into boxes.

preparations.title: Smoky Three-Bean Batch (Dinner Portion)
preparations.method: Cooked simultaneously with the lunch batch in the same pot. Simmer until rich and smoky, then portion into dinner boxes.

preparations.title: Roasted Summer Vegetables (Lunch Portion)
preparations.method: Chop vegetables into chunks. Toss with oil and smoked paprika. Roast on a single tray at 200C for 25 minutes until charred.

preparations.title: Roasted Summer Vegetables (Dinner Portion)
preparations.method: Roasted on the same tray as the lunch vegetables. Portion once charred and tender.

preparations.title: Steamed Brown Rice
preparations.method: Rinse rice and boil in salted water until tender (about 25-30 mins). Drain and portion.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the brown rice on the stove. Preheat the oven and chop all peppers, courgettes, and red onions; toss them in oil and smoked paprika on the single oven tray and roast. While they roast, sauté the onions for the beans in a large pot, add the chipotle paste, beans, and tomatoes, and leave to simmer. Once everything is cooked, divide the beans and vegetables into lunch and dinner boxes, and portion the rice for tonight's dinner.
